effect.name: GM Twirl
effect.desc: A twirl with real structure. The twist profile is a power curve over the radius, so the falloff control moves the effect from a tight knot at the centre to a wide slow rotation that reaches the edge. Six looks: a plain twirl, a whirlpool that also scales with the twist, a spiral that couples the radius to the angle, a pinch twirl, a black hole that pulls inward and darkens the core, and a double twirl whose two lobes counter-rotate. Ring ripple, turbulence, spin, and clamp/mirror/wrap sampling are all separate controls. Measured in layer space around a layer point.
